Target landscape: Six living players: a claimed trailseer whose night 2 follow is the only public result touching the lynched chanteuse; a claimed healer whose night 2 was blocked by the lynched chanteuse; and four players with no claim. No candidate has confirmed role status, and the only evidence is one unverified claim plus behavioral accusations.
lesson_action: After both wolves are dead and only a hidden lone killer remains, hold fire while no living player is tied to a lone-killer signal. Keep the bullets for when a reanimated-body kill or other concrete evidence points at a specific suspect.
stated_reason: The wolf chanteuse is dead and only the illusionist and a hidden necromancer remain, with no lone-killer signal yet, so holding fire keeps both bullets.
